description: Searches the published VistaShares FAQs (fund pages, fund family pages and About) and returns matching questions and answers with their source page.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Accepts 1 to 10; default 5.

query.description: Question or keywords, for example "When does OMAH pay distributions?". Required; words of three letters or fewer are ignored.

ticker.description: Optional: search only this fund's FAQs. Omit to search every fund page plus the family and About pages.

name: search_faq

disclosure.description: Disclosure to show with the data.

title: Search VistaShares FAQs
